stories.title: Rogue corgi Quinn jukes her handlers at Panthers-Broncos halftime
stories.summary: During the Panthers' halftime corgi race, a one-year-old corgi named Quinn ran off across the field, juking at least four diving handlers and delaying the second-half kickoff. Fans demanded she get a contract.

stories.title: Rogue corgi Quinn jukes her handlers at Panthers-Broncos halftime
stories.summary: A corgi went rogue during the Panthers' halftime corgi race, and it took a group of diving staffers to finally tackle it.
